itens.titulo: Pharmac extends limit for cancer medicine to be funded in private hospitals
itens.resumo: Associate Health Minister David Seymour has today welcomed Pharmac’s decision to extend the 12-month transitional access funding limit for Pertuzumab with trastuzumab (Phesgo) for people receiving treatment for certain types of breast cancer in private clinics. “In the past, when Pharmac funded a new cancer treatment, people already paying for that treatment privately are forced to make a very...
itens.titulo_pt: Pharmac amplia limite para o financiamento de medicamentos contra o cancro em hospitais privados
itens.resumo_pt: O Ministro Associado da Saúde, David Seymour, saudou hoje a decisão da Pharmac de alargar o limite de financiamento de acesso transitório de 12 meses para Pertuzumab com trastuzumab (Phesgo) para pessoas que recebem tratamento para certos tipos de cancro da mama em clínicas privadas.

itens.resumo: Attorney-General Hon Chris Bishop has announced the appointment of Vanessa Curac as a District Court Judge. Ms Curac has been practising law for 25 years, having started out as a solicitor for Oranga Tamariki, before becoming a Barrister in 2004, working in the Youth, Family and Criminal Courts. itens.resumo_pt: O procurador-geral Hon Chris Bishop anunciou a nomeação de Vanessa Curac como juíza do Tribunal Distrital. A Sra. Curac pratica a lei há 25 anos, tendo começado como advogada de Oranga Tamariki, antes de se tornar Barrister em 2004, trabalhando nos Tribunais da Juventude, Família e Criminal.
